FEAT-6-S123.title: Consent Schema and Data Contract Definition
FEAT-6-S123.description: Define MongoDB schema and Pydantic models for consent records including tier designation, timestamping, conversation linkage, and audit fields. Ensure compatibility with existing consent_models and lead capture integration.

FEAT-6-S124.title: Consent API and Tool Interface
FEAT-6-S124.description: Expose consent workflow through FastAPI endpoints and tool_router integration, enabling the LLM to trigger consent capture, tier escalation, and validation during conversations.

FEAT-6-S125.title: Consent Workflow Test Coverage
FEAT-6-S125.description: Implement unit and integration tests validating consent tier transitions, de-identification enforcement, and API behavior. Include edge cases for partial consent and invalid transitions.
